newsitem.title: UK: Reed director to step down early.
newsitem.headline: Reed director to step down early.

text.p: Ian Thomas, who had been due to retire as a director of Reed International in May 1997, is to step down from October 1, 1996, the company said in a statement.
A Reed director since 1990, Thomas has brought forward his departure in order to pursue a number of other business interests, the company said.
He will be resigning his directorships with Reed International Plc and with all companies in the Reed Elsevier Plc group from that date.
His duties as chief executive of the Reed Travel Group will be filled by Kathy Misunas, who joined the company in May.
